localChanges: On the pixel art, where one terrain stops it now fades into the land around it rather than stopping at a line, and a lone square of it has rounder corners.
Grassland, plains, desert, tundra, arctic, glacier and swamp now run right up to the beach on the pixel art, rather than stopping in a strip of grass.

log: Where a terrain stops, it now fades into the land over a few pixels through an ordered dither and a blended edge, with a thinner fringe of grass, on all three packs. A lone tile's corners are rounder, so it reads as a patch. Grassland, plains, desert, tundra, arctic (and Glacier) and swamp count the sea as joined, so they run right up to the beach rather than stopping in a strip of grass.
